news.title: Brandin Podziemski scores 18 points as Warriors hold of Celtics 88-87 to snap five-game losing skid
news.text: — Brandin Podziemski had 18 points and seven rebounds and the Golden State Warriors snapped a five-game losing streak by holding off Boston for an 88-87 win Sunday night, sending the Celtics to their first four-game skid in five years.

news.title: Draymond Green swats back at online critics, fuels Warriors' win over Celtics
news.text: After reinforcing his career​ accolades earlier in the day on social media, Golden State Warriors forward Draymond Green closed out an 88-87 win over the Boston Celtics on Sunday with a last-second defensive stop and rousing celebration from the veteran.

news.title: Grizzlies roll past short-handed Warriors 126-98 for a fifth straight win
news.text: — Jaylen Wells had 22 points and Cedric Coward scored 19 to lead the Memphis Grizzlies to their fifth straight win on Thursday night, 126-98 over the short-handed Golden State Warriors.

news.title: Fears' first triple-double leads the Pelicans past the Warriors 115-94
news.text: — Jeremiah Fears had 19 points, 10 assists and 10 rebounds for his first career triple-double, and the New Orleans Pelicans snapped a six-game losing streak with a 115-94 victory over the Golden State Warriors on Monday night.

news.title: Warriors' Yaxel Lendeborg (1-for-13) 'flustered' in blowout loss to Spurs
news.text: In his first game as the primary offensive engine in place of the injured Stephen Curry, Warriors rookie Yaxel Lendeborg went 1-of-13 shooting in a 123-85 blowout loss to the Spurs. "I was flustered the entire game," he said. "Couldn't make a damn layup."

news.title: Castle scores season-high 32 points as Spurs stop the Warriors 123-85 for 11th straight win
news.text: — Stephon Castle scored a season-high 32 points, Victor Wembanyama had 12 points and 12 rebounds and the San Antonio Spurs won their 11th straight game, rolling past the Golden State Warriors 123-85 Friday night to remain unbeaten in NBA Cup play.

news.title: Rockets' Marcus Smart suspended three games for punch
news.text: The NBA on Thursday suspended Rockets guard Marcus Smart three games without pay for throwing a punch at Warriors center Charles Bassey.

news.title: Warriors' Stephen Curry out at least 2 weeks with oblique tear
news.text: Stephen Curry will miss at least two weeks with an oblique abdominal tear, but sources told ESPN that the Warriors are bracing for him to be out closer to a month.
